html:
G'oya

Foydalanuvchi qaysi kuni yangi ekanini bilish uchun uning birinchi kirish kunini bilish yetarli. Bitta CTE har foydalanuvchining MIN(day) sini topadi, ikkinchisi takroriy kirishlarni olib tashlab, faqat (foydalanuvchi, kun) juftliklarini qoldiradi. Keyin har bir juftlikni birinchi kun bilan solishtirib, kun bo'yicha sanaymiz.

Yechim

WITH firsts AS (
  SELECT user_id, MIN(day) AS first_day
  FROM logins
  GROUP BY user_id
),
daily AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, day FROM logins
)
SELECT d.day,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d.day = f.first_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_users,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d.day > f.first_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returning_users
FROM daily d
JOIN firsts f ON f.user_id = d.user_id
GROUP BY d.day

Namunada 3-kuni to'rt kishi kirgan: 4-foydalanuvchi birinchi marta, qolgan uchtasi avval ham bo'lgan. Natija 3 | 1 | 3. Kun hech qachon birinchi kundan oldin bo'lmaydi, shuning uchun ikki CASE har bir juftlikni aniq bitta tomonga qo'shadi.

Tuzoqlar

DISTINCT siz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri logins ni ulash. Bir kunda uch marta kirgan foydalanuvchi uch marta sanaladi:

Noto'g'riWITH firsts AS (
  SELECT user_id, MIN(day) AS first_day
  FROM logins
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT l.day,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.day = f.first_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_users,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.day > f.first_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returning_users
FROM logins l
JOIN firsts f ON f.user_id = l.user_id
GROUP BY l.day

Qaytganlarni COUNT(*) bilan sanash ham xato: u o'sha kungi hamma foydalanuvchini, yangilarini ham qo'shib sanaydi.

Boshqa yo'l

Birinchi kunni oyna funksiyasi bilan har bir qatorning yoniga qo'yish mumkin, alohida JOIN kerak bo'lmaydi:

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, day FROM logins
),
m AS (
  SELECT user_id, day, MIN(day) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id) AS first_day
  FROM d
)
SELECT day,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN day = first_day THEN 1 END) AS new_users,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN day > first_day THEN 1 END) AS returning_users
FROM m
GROUP BY day
